about: Huron East is a municipality in Huron County, Ontario, centred on Seaforth and Brussels—not a city. Heritage main streets, farmland, and former railway villages share the rich agricultural plain inland from Lake Huron. About 10,000 people live in Huron East.
seoSummary: Huron County municipality around Seaforth and Brussels—heritage main streets and farmland, not a city.
